name: Gaussian Splatting for Microscopy
definition: Decomposes an nD microscopy volume V into a mixture of K anisotropic Gaussians to represent nD images, enabling interactive web visualization and compression.
summary: Gaussian Splatting for Microscopy represents n-dimensional fluorescence volumes as oriented Gaussian primitives for interactive web visualization, avoiding voxel grids and using blind-spot cross-validation to prevent overfitting.
